features: EXTREME PROTECTIVE OUTDOOR HAT: This bucket sun hat is made of premium quick-drying nylon. The bucket hat surface is equipped with water-resistant coating, water-resistant capacity >200kpa, when you explore outdoors, do not worry about a light rain. The newly upgraded UPF50+ fabric is specially processed to provide lasting and effective sun protection, blocking more than 99% of harmful rays

ULTRA BREATHABLE FABRIC FOR COMFORT: Unlike typical water-resistant fabrics that lack air flow, our bucket hat is both water-resistant and breathable, with air permeability up to 7500g/m²/24h. The lightweight crown adds no pressure, and 4 side eyelets enhance ventilation. A wide pure-cotton sweatband is soft, skin-friendly, and moisture-wicking, keeping you dry and cool in summer

LIGHTER AND MORE PROTABLE: The water-resistant bucket hat is lightweight, only 2.2 ounces (62g). Excellent quality never afraid of comparison. The sun hat is made of imported material, which is tear resistant, scratch resistant and wear resistant. Upgraded windproof rope, easy to adjust, more firm, not easy to lose, avoid wind blowing away the hat. The rain hat can be folded without deformation, reducing the use of space, can be put in a pocket or bag, easy to store and carry, free your hands

ADJUSTABLE DRAWSTRING TO FIT MORE: The water-resistant sun hat has a maximum head circumference of 23.62 inches (60 cm) and an innovative adjustable stretchy drawstring at the back, making it perfect for both men and women. We always consider the safety and comfort of outdoor enthusiasts. We pay attention to every detail. After many tests, the product development department came up with the perfect brim width and angle, which effectively sunscreen and does not block the view

POPULAR AND VERSATILE: We insist on the integration of fashion and function to create excellent quality bucket hats. With advanced technology and excellent workmanship, we aim to provide water-resistant , windproof and breathable sun hats. This wide-brimmed floppy waterproof sun hat is perfect for everyday use and outdoor activities. You can use it as a fishing hat, hiking hat, safari hat and bucket hat, or just a sun protection hat for everyday yard work.
